Elias climbed the spiral stairs, listening to the wind worry at the shutters. The lamp turned faithfully above him, sweeping the sea in its measured circle. Beneath the first words, almost invisible, another message appeared: “Do not let it see shore.”","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时停下来的机器。高架桥上偶有货车掠过，轮胎声在空旷的楼群间拖得很长。便利店仍亮着白灯，店员伏在柜台后打盹，咖啡机发出低低的喘息。路口的红绿灯固执地变换，却没有行人等待。远处写字楼的几扇窗还亮着，像疲倦而不肯闭上的眼睛。清洁车缓慢驶过，水痕映着霓虹的残色。风从河边吹来，带着潮湿的凉意；再过不久，第一班地铁和第一声鸟鸣，会把这座城市重新叫醒。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem is solved by asking a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Each smaller problem must move toward a simple stopping point, called a base case.\n- For example, to count down from five, say five, then ask yourself to count down from four until you reach zero."}
